newsitem.title: USA: NASD names head of investment firm regulation dept.
newsitem.headline: NASD names head of investment firm regulation dept.

text.p: NASD Regulation Inc said Thursday it named securities lawyer Thomas Selman as director of its advertising/investment companies regulation department.
The position had been vacant after R. Clark Hooper was named senior vice president of the office of disclosure and investor protection last May, NASD said.

Selman would develop policy related to distribution, marketing and sales practices of investment company and variable contract securities by NASD member firms, including those operating on bank premises, NASD said.
He would also oversee investment company advertising and sales literature, NASD said.
Selman was an associate counsel for the Investment Company Institute, the national trade association of the U.S. mutual fund industry.
